tooltipOperationDescription: Comment or description of the Process
tooltipOperationItemsCovers: The number of items that the process covers. For example, in shoemaking, inspection might be in pairs and so this would be for 2 shoes. Pallet stitching might have 6 pieces in the pallet where 4 pieces are needed per shoe. In this case this covers 1.5 shoes. Similarly, if there are 2 pieces in the pallet but 4 are needed per shoe then this covers 0.5 shoes. For the vast majority of processes this should be set to 1.
tooltipOperationOperationClass: What category of Process? Lasting, punching, roughing, etc.
tooltipOperationMainstyle: Main design to associate with process. This can be left blank.
tooltipOperationOperationType: For example if Class is 'attach insole' the type could be 'melt' or 'tape'
tooltipOperationDepartment: Where does the Process take place?
tooltipOperationQuestionGrade: What is the grade rate of the process?
tooltipOperationQuestionRest: Additional time added to allow for worker rest (percentage)
tooltipOperationQuestionContingency: Additional time added to allow for unexpected delays (percentage)
tooltipOperationQuestionKnivesFreq: The number of components that are required
tooltipOperationQuestionKnivesNett: The actual area of the knife in Square feet
tooltipOperationQuestionKnivesPieces: The number of pieces cut by the knife
tooltipOperationQuestionKnivesPeels: The number of peeling actions needed to extract the piece from the knife to punch tubes or similar obstructions contained within the knife
tooltipOperationQuestionKnivesClears: The number of times the knife is used before it is cleared
tooltipOperationQuestionKnivesLtoR: Set Cuts L + R if only one knife is required to cut a left and a right component. This is when it is double sided or the same knife is used for both left and right componenets
tooltipOperationQuestionKnivesThin: Set thin if the cut parts have to be extracted from the knife with a tool
tooltipOperationQuestionKnivesBands: The number of elastic bands removed from or put onto the bundles
tooltipOperationQuestionKnivesMarks: The number of marking strokes made on the top cut part
tooltipRefreshDescription: Refresh to load changes that may have been made by other users
tooltipSystemMaxSpeed: The maximum stitching speed the system uses for each option
tooltipSystemMinSpeed: The minimum stitching speed the system uses for each option
tooltipSystemGrades: Select or create a grade (if used) for processes. The rate is a monetary value per minute
tooltipSystemMachiningAmendmentsCm: The length of stitch path which is affected by the amended speed is read when the process is created. To change this for an existing process requires the process to be recreated.

helpModalList1: A batch is moved to the workstation, possible in a box.
helpModalList2: Work is moved to the work area - an area of the workstation adjacent to where the task will be done. Preparations such as removing bands, splitting and sorting happens here.
helpModalList3: Individual pieces are moved to the centre for a manual task or directly to a machine. There is ONE movement only between each set of finished and new pieces. When two hands are moved at the same time only count ONE movement.
helpModalParagraph1: Handling ends and the task begins with the piece(s) in the centre or at/in the machine. Any movements made during the task are part of the task itself. At the end of the task, the hand is holding or next to the piece(s) ready to move them back to the work area.
helpModalParagraph2: This is for all general stitching Processes. The path only describes the time the piece is in the stitching machine. Mark all features on the path where they occur.
